subject: POC kickoff & timeline for Acme Corp trial

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & timeline for Acme Corp trial

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned on success criteria, timeline, and ownership:}

- Success criteria (what Acme told us today):
  - 95% intent classification accuracy on your customer support transcripts for the top 10 intents
  - < 250ms 95th percentile token latency for interactive agent flows
  - Demonstrated ability to host inference in your EU region (data residency)

- Evaluation plan:
  1) Week 0 (Prep): RW provides POC SOW, access checklist, and a short eval dataset template. Acme provides sample transcripts and baseline metrics.
  2) Week 1 (Kickoff + environment setup): Private sandbox access (VPC peering / restricted endpoint), SSO and KMS onboarding, initial model selection.
  3) Weeks 2–4 (Run experiments): RW and Acme run test prompts, monitor latency/cost, iterate on prompt templates and quantization settings. Weekly check-ins to review metrics.
  4) Week 5 (Final readout): Joint results, recommendations, and next-step proposal (production plan and pricing).

- Ownership / point people:
  - Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Monica (SE / model tuning), Stephanie (security & compliance)
  - Acme: Samantha (PM), Carlos (Infrastructure)

- Proposed timeline (flexible): Kickoff the week of Apr 19, weekly 30-min check-ins on Tuesdays, final readout the week of May 24.

Next steps for this week:
- I’ll send the POC SOW and an evaluation dataset template (attaching SOW draft).
- Samantha — can you confirm availability for a kickoff the week of Apr 19 and share a small sample of transcripts (anonymized) by EOD Thu?
- Carlos — can you confirm whether Acme needs an EU-hosted endpoint or if a US-hosted private endpoint is fine for the trial?

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow.pdf (draft), acme-eval-criteria.xlsx (template)

Thanks —

Marissa Cole

Thanks, Marissa — great recap. A few quick notes from our side:

- Confirming the success criteria above; we'll add one more internal metric around false positives on intent classification (target < 5% on the top 5 intents).
- Kickoff week of Apr 19 works for Samantha and most of the team; can we do Tue Apr 20 at 10am PT?
- For the trial we need the EU-hosted endpoint due to our data residency policy. We can provide a sanitized dataset by Thu EOD.
- On SSO: we use Okta; we'll need an SAML test connector for the sandbox.

Also — can you clarify whether the POC will include streaming responses (we'd like to test interactive agent flows)?
